verdict.rationale: Codegen is driven by natural-language prompts. Its docs say it analyzes requirements, implements features, fixes bugs and writes tests "based on your prompts." Users can talk to the agent directly in Slack, mention it in PR or issue comments, and run it programmatically with a plain-English prompt (e.g. agent.run(prompt="Leave a review on PR #123")). missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that natural-language commands work reliably in practice, since all evidence is vendor documentation.
